title: BAFTA®-Qualifying HollyShorts London 2025
deck: The second London edition, from poster to award show.
lede: A second year in London meant growing the identity without starting over. The 2025 system carried from the poster to the jury, the schedule and the award show screen.
challenge: After the first London edition in 2024, the second needed to keep evolving the visual identity established in the inaugural year and take it across every part of the festival.
work: The second year kept the hand-drawn London of the first and widened it to the parts of a festival that live on screens and paper: the jury, the schedule, the invitation and the award show.

The system runs from the poster to a set of award show slides (welcome, London, honoree and grand prize), jury graphics, on-screen visuals in landscape and vertical formats, the schedule, the badge, the invitation and the step-and-repeat.
credits: Dalton Corr: creative direction and design
press: British Cinematographer covered the second annual HollyShorts London.
